content.text:
The test passes. 

The change request — "narrow the invoices list to one stage" — is implemented as an additive front-end filter on the All Invoices page:

- Added an `invoice-status-filter` `<select>` (with an "All stages" default plus DRAFT / SENT / PAID options matching the invoice lifecycle from the V5/V8 migrations).
- Selecting a stage filters the rendered `invoice-row-*` rows to invoices at that status; the empty value shows all.

No schema or server changes were needed — `GET /api/invoices/all` already returns each invoice's `status`, and the seed support already accepts the fixture shape the spec uses. The change is contained to `AllInvoicesPage.tsx`, keeping it local and additive per CLAUDE.md. `bin/e2e` passes (1/1).
